rubric: A small change on plan, but a person changed what the machine made six times: the machine's own work was wrong in ways a retro should learn from.

criteria.worth: Would a retro of this task teach the next one something? The diagram's five signals: a prediction that missed (size, risk, urgency), many iterations or review rounds, an escalation, a person overriding what the machine made, a downgraded format or a repeated finding. Facts about the task, not instructions to you.

reading.why: On plan in size, but a person overrode what the machine made six times: one of the five signals, and the machine's own work was wrong in ways a retro can learn from.
